description: This Java source file defines the class CompressedDDataHandler, which manages compressed distributed data hashes using Akka actors and provides methods for creating, compressing, and retrieving hash data for topics in a pub-sub system.

classes.name: CompressedDDataHandler
classes.description: A handler for managing compressed distributed hash data for pub-sub topics, capable of creating instances, compressing data, and accessing hash seeds.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CompressedDDataHandler configured with actor system and pub-sub configuration; initializes hash seeds based on configuration.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Returns the list of hash seeds used by this handler.

methods.name: approximate
methods.description: Compresses a topic string into a ByteString representing hash codes using multiple hash functions.

methods.name: hashCodesToByteString
methods.description: Converts a list of hash integers into a ByteString for storage or transmission.
